svg.title: Know My Professor system diagram
svg.desc: Top half: Cloud Scheduler triggers seven scrape jobs that crawl public sources, use Claude or Gemini to extract fields, and write JSON to a Cloud Storage bucket; an ingest job chunks the records, embeds them with Mistral and upserts them into a Pinecone index with three namespaces. Bottom half: a student asks a question on knowmyprof.web.app, which frames the Streamlit frontend; it posts to the FastAPI kmp-api service, which embeds the question with Mistral, queries each Pinecone namespace, reranks the results, and has Claude Opus 5 write a cited answer. A maintainer's pull request to main triggers Cloud Build, which deploys every job and service.
